<h1>Line figures and marks</h1>
<p class="sg-lede">Line geometry and printed marks in black: the exact Metatron&#x27;s cube, the egg of life, a seed rosette, interlaced and knot marks, a kolam line pattern and two checkerboards. 1000px PNGs, with SVGs where they are small and clean.</p>
<dl class="sg-facts"><dt>Use for</dt><dd>Structure and quiet order: essays, papers, diagrams, section breaks.</dd><dt>Colour</dt><dd>Black only (--ink), fixed in the file: they don&#x27;t follow the page colour or turn chalk on night. Don&#x27;t tint them.</dd><dt>Grounds</dt><dd>White, Paper, Sunlight</dd><dt>Registers</dt><dd>Study, Conversation</dd><dt>Formats</dt><dd>PNG; SVG where small</dd><dt>Rights</dt><dd>Not cleared. Traced or cut from mood board images whose rights are not cleared: fine for mockups and drafts; redraw, re-source or clear before anything goes public.</dd></dl>
